text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: One peaceful day, with the Twinkle Series behind us…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Sweep Tosho gets to fulfill her long-awaited wish of showing her grandmother around the academy.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Welcome to my school!

text_block_list.name: Sweep's Grandma
text_block_list.text: Ahaha! Everything's just how I remember!

text_block_list.name: Sweep's Grandma
text_block_list.text: Thank you for arranging everything, Trainer. I was impressed you went so far as to think about my transportation as well.
choice_data_list: It was no trouble at all.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Ugh. Don't stand there all day, Grandma! There's so much I wanna show you!

text_block_list.name: Sweep's Grandma
text_block_list.text: Oh, is that right? I wonder what it could be…

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: You'll just have to wait and see! Hehe, this way! ♪

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Look, Grandma! These are my apprentices!

text_block_list.name: Sweep's Grandma
text_block_list.text: My, Sweepy! You've taken on apprentices?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: That's right. C'mon, everyone! Show Grandma some respect!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with Blue Ribbons
text_block_list.text: H-hello! It's a pleasure to meet you!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: It's lovely to meet you.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Wait, what?! Since when are we all your apprentices?!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Vodka! Shhh! Her grandmother is here to visit.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: She's trying to look good for her, so show a little awareness and help her out!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Hey! Pipe down over there, you two!

text_block_list.name: Sweep's Grandma
text_block_list.text: Haha, that's wonderful, Sweepy! It takes tolerance truly befitting a teacher to cultivate such vivacious students.

text_block_list.name: Sweep's Grandma
text_block_list.text: I'm so happy to see you all getting along so well.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Uh, yeah! Of course! And…

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Okay, that's enough chitchat! Next, I want us all to put on a race for Grandma!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Familiar! Show Grandma to the best seat in the house!

text_block_list.name: Sweep's Grandma
text_block_list.text: Hehe… It looks like Sweepy has made a lot of good friends.

text_block_list.name: Sweep's Grandma
text_block_list.text: …I don't have to worry anymore.

text_block_list.name: Sweep's Grandma
text_block_list.text: Oh, yes. I was so worried whether or not she would fit in when she first started. She gets so anxious around strangers and has no filter.

text_block_list.name: Sweep's Grandma
text_block_list.text: I was worried the others might get the wrong idea about her.

text_block_list.name: Sweep's Grandma
text_block_list.text: But it looks like there was nothing to worry about. She has so many wonderful people around her.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Hi, Sweep. Are you all training together today?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: That's right. Do you wanna join? We're about to have a one-lap race!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: …A race.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Of course! I'll go get changed right away! I want to beat you, after all.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Really?! Rob Roy is running too?!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: I'm not ready to go up against two of the strongest runners I know! I need advance warning!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Oh, is somebody scared? I'm feeling totally fine over here.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Ngh…

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Heh-heh. I'm the one who's gonna win the Derby, after all. Racing those two should be a great warm-up!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Hey, it's not just you! I have goals too, you kn—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Daiwa Scarlet glances at Sweep Tosho.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Hm? What is it?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Hey, now! If you don't stop that fighting, I'll have to whack you one!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Huff… Huff… I'm… good to go!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Already?!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Okay, everyone, get into position! Ready, set…

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Go!

text_block_list.name: Scarlet and Vodka
text_block_list.text: Wheeze… Wheeze…

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: I wiiiiin!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: That acceleration was insane…

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Oh my gosh! We've got an emergency! Vodka, get on my back! I'll take you to the infirmary!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: H-hold on, Kawakami! You can relax. I think she just had a buildup of lactic acid.

text_block_list.name: Sweep's Grandma
text_block_list.text: Heeheehee! You've certainly gathered an interesting bunch of apprentices, Sweepy!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Duh, Grandma! It's me we're talking about!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Everyone still has a long way to go, but that's why I'm giving them plenty of training!

text_block_list.name: Sweep's Grandma
text_block_list.text: Oh dear. Your training sounds quite unforgiving. I hope your apprentices don't run off on you.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: …Wait. Scarlet! Are you thinking of running off?!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Wh-why are you singling me out?! Sigh…

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: But… hypothetically speaking, I don't think that a Sweep apprentice would be the type to run off.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: She's very kind and, more importantly, she's someone that you can respect.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: I want to win a Grand Prix too. I also want to put on a great race that will stand out vividly in people's memories. Just like she did.

text_block_list.name: Sweep's Grandma
text_block_list.text: Oh?

text_block_list.name: Sweep's Grandma
text_block_list.text: I see. It looks like Sweepy really does have an apprentice.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Do you really have to go already?!

text_block_list.name: Sweep's Grandma
text_block_list.text: Sad as it is, it appears my train has arrived.

text_block_list.name: Sweep's Grandma
text_block_list.text: But there's no need to be distressed. Why don't you come visit me next time?

text_block_list.name: Sweep's Grandma
text_block_list.text: Feel free to bring your trainer and all your friends and apprentices as well. Bring the whole gang!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Really?! Are you sure?!

text_block_list.name: Sweep's Grandma
text_block_list.text: Of course. I'll make sure to keep the house nice and tidy.

text_block_list.name: Sweep's Grandma
text_block_list.text: From now on, you need to oversee the growth of racing magic in order to cultivate the skills of your apprentices.

text_block_list.name: Sweep's Grandma
text_block_list.text: You've changed the world through your racing magic. That girl earlier felt it. Being a witch means taking responsibility and seeing things through to the end.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Hm? …Okay.
choice_data_list: We'll pass her style on to the next generation.

text_block_list.name: Sweep's Grandma
text_block_list.text: Hahaha… I'm counting on you, Trainer. I can rest easy knowing you'll be here with her.

text_block_list.name: Sweep's Grandma
text_block_list.text: I'll see you soon, Sweepy. Until then, you enjoy every moment here to the fullest.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Of course! Hehe, see you!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Sweep Tosho's grandmother keeps looking back and nodding politely.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And Sweep Tosho and I wave back each time.
